context_requirements: Expression of functional TACR1, TACR2, or TACR3 on the cell surface
An autocrine or paracrine tachykinin ligand (TAC1-derived peptides) driving receptor activity
Receptor-proximal signaling that converges on transcriptional effectors; not established in these lines
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is absent in vehicle controls and consistent with TACR1/2/3 antagonism
Evidence of tachykinin receptor expression and active tachykinin signaling in these lines that is reversed by the antagonist
